<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

  <title>SmartVoiceX — AI employee for phone operations</title>

  <meta name="twitter:description" content="Deploy a custom AI voice agent for inbound and outbound calls, appointment workflows, transfers, multilingual support, and integrations.">

  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/svx-auth.css">
  <!-- liquid-glass-sidecard.css removed (superseded by svx-webgl-bg) -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/liquid-glass/svx-webgl-bg.css?v=20260402">

  <!-- Firebase (compat builds for static hosting) -->
  <script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
  <script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-auth-compat.js"></script>
  <script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.22.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js"></script>
  <script src="/assets/svx-auth.js" defer></script>

  <style>
    :root{
      /* Base palette (RGB triplets for easy alpha usage) */
      --c-black: 0 0 0;
      --c-white: 255 255 255;
      --c-blue: 79 123 255;
      --c-purple: 98 20 217;

      /* Semantic colors */
      --bg: rgb(var(--c-black) / 1);
      --bg2: rgb(var(--c-black) / 1);

      --panel: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.06);
      --panel2: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.08);
      --border: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.12);

      --text: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.92);
      --muted: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.68);
      --muted2: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.55);

      /* Brand */
      --svx-purple: rgb(var(--c-purple) / 1);
      --svx-blue: rgb(var(--c-blue) / 1);
      --c-blueText: 122 166 255;
      --svx-blueText: rgb(var(--c-blueText) / 1);
      --svx-white: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.95);

      --accent: var(--svx-purple);
      --accent2: var(--svx-blue);

      --ring: rgb(var(--c-purple) / 0.35);
      --shadow: rgb(var(--c-black) / 0.40);

      /* Frequently-used overlays */
      --glass-1: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.05);
      --glass-2: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.10);
      --glass-3: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.14);
      --ink-1: rgb(var(--c-black) / 0.10);
      --ink-2: rgb(var(--c-black) / 0.22);
    }

    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html,body{height:100%}
    html{scroll-padding-top: calc(96px + 3vh)}
    body{
      margin:0;
      background: var(--bg);
      color:var(--text);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

    .container{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
    .topbar .container{max-width:1200px}

    /* Navbar (match /pages/contact.html vibe: pill, blur, subtle border) */
    /* Static top strip background (does NOT follow scroll) */
    .topbar-bg{
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 96px;
      background: var(--bg2);
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events:none;
    }

    /* Fixed navbar (does follow scroll) */
    .topbar{
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 100%;
      z-index: 20;
      padding: 20px 0;
      pointer-events: none; /* only inner pill should capture clicks */
      background: transparent;
    }

    body{padding-top: 96px}

    .nav{
      pointer-events: auto;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:16px;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.10);
      background: rgb(var(--c-black) / 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      box-shadow: 0px 4px 10px -2px rgb(var(--c-black) / 0.10), 0px 2px 2px -1px rgb(var(--c-black) / 0.10);
    }

    .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:950}
    .logo-img{
      width:45px;
      height:40px;
      border-radius: 0;
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: none;
      background: transparent;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
    }

    .navlinks{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;color:rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.84);font-weight:800;font-size:13px}
    .navlinks a{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px}
    .navlinks a:hover{background: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.06); color: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.92)}

    .navutil{
      font-weight:850;
      font-size:13px;
      color: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.78);
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0);
      background: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0);
    }
    .navutil:hover{background: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.06); color: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.92)}

    .topbar .btn{border-radius:999px; padding:10px 14px}

    .hero{position:relative; padding:74px 0 26px 0; overflow: visible}

    .hero-bg{
      position:absolute;
      top:0;
      bottom:0;

      /* Full-bleed without causing layout overflow */
      left: 50%;
      width: 150vw;
      transform: translateX(-50%);

      pointer-events:none;
      border-radius: 0;
      /* extended falloff (starts 13% earlier) */
      background: linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 0%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 72%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 0) 95%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 0) 100%
      );
      z-index:0;
    }
    .hero > *:not(.hero-bg){position:relative; z-index:1}

    /* Solid black band w/ hero-matching falloff (used for capabilities → integrations) */
    .solid-band{position:relative; z-index:0}
    .solid-band-bg{
      position:absolute;
      top:0;
      bottom:0;
      left: 50%;
      width: 100vw;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      pointer-events:none;
      background: linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 0) 0%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 10%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 82%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 0) 100%
      );
      z-index:-1;
    }
    .solid-band > *:not(.solid-band-bg){position:relative; z-index:1}

    /* Footer variant: no bottom gradient; fade extends upward into the section above. */
    .solid-band--footer{
      /* Pull the band upward so the top fade overlaps the section above */
      --footer-fade: 150px;
      margin-top: calc(var(--footer-fade) * -1);
      padding-top: var(--footer-fade);
    }
    .solid-band--footer .solid-band-bg{
      /* Extend the background above the wrapper so the fade has room */
      top: calc(var(--footer-fade) * -1);
      bottom: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 0) 0%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 55%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 100%
      );
    }

    .journey{display:grid;grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.75fr;gap:18px;align-items:start}
    .journey-main{min-width:0}

    h1{margin:0;font-size:54px;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-0.06em}
    .sub{margin-top:14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;max-width:56ch}

    .cta-row{margin-top:18px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}

    .btn{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.06);
      color: var(--text);
      font-weight: 950;
      font-size: 13px;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    .btn.primary{background: rgb(var(--c-purple) / 0.84); border-color: rgb(var(--c-purple) / 0.92)}
    .btn.primary:hover{background: rgb(var(--c-purple) / 0.96)}
    .btn.secondary:hover{background: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.09)}
    .btn.ghost{background: var(--ink-1)}
    .btn.ghost:hover{background: var(--ink-2)}

    .note{margin-top:10px;color:var(--muted2);font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}

    .proof{margin-top: 22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
    .pill{
      font-weight:900;
      font-size:12px;
      color: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.86);
      padding:8px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.10);
      background: var(--glass-1);
    }

    .card{
      border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.12);
      background: transparent;
      border-radius: 21px;
      padding: calc(14px * 1.07);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 70px var(--shadow);
    }
    .card > b{text-align:center; display:block}

    .side-card{position:sticky; top: 88px; margin: 18px 0}

    .side-title{font-weight:1000;font-size:14px}
    .side-sub{margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:750;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}

    .side-list{margin-top:10px;display:grid;gap:8px}
    .side-item{padding:10px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.10);background:var(--ink-2)}
    .side-item b{display:block;font-size:12px}
    .side-item span{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted2);font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:750}

    .section{padding:38px 0}
    .kicker{
      /* standard kicker background */
      --kicker-w: 33vw;
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:flex-start;
      text-align:left;
      width: var(--kicker-w);
      max-width: 100%;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 0%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 1) 69%,
        rgb(var(--c-black) / 0) 90%
      );

      color: var(--svx-blueText);
      font-weight:950;
      font-size:12px;
      letter-spacing:0.08em;
      text-transform:uppercase;
    }
    .h2{margin:10px 0 0 0; font-size:34px; letter-spacing:-0.05em; line-height:1.12}
    .lead{margin-top:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;max-width:76ch}

    .grid{margin-top:16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);gap:12px}
    .grid .card b{display:block;font-size:13px}
    .grid .card p{margin:8px 0 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}

    .split{display:grid;grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}

    .overview-gif-wrap{margin-top:14px}
    .overview-gif{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius: 18px;border: 0;box-shadow: 0 22px 80px rgb(var(--c-black) / 0.35)}

    /* Timeline slider */
    .timeline{margin-top:14px}
    .timeline-track{position:relative;height:18px;margin:10px 2px 0 2px}
    .timeline-track::before{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      left:0;right:0;top:50%;
      height:2px;
      transform:translateY(-50%);
      background: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.12);
      border-radius:999px;
    }
    .timeline-thumb{
      position:absolute;
      top:50%;
      width:14px;height:14px;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      border-radius:999px;
      background: rgb(var(--c-blue) / 0.92);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 6px rgb(var(--c-blue) / 0.18),
        0 0 24px rgb(var(--c-blue) / 0.40);
      cursor:grab;
      touch-action:none;
    }
    .timeline-thumb:active{cursor:grabbing}
    .timeline-text{margin-top:12px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-weight:750;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}

    .logo-cloud{margin-top:14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
    .logo{
      padding:10px 12px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.10);
      background: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.04);
      color: rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.78);
      font-weight:900;
      font-size:12px;
      letter-spacing:0.02em;
    }

    .metrics{margin-top:14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);gap:12px}
    .metric{border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.10);background:var(--ink-2);border-radius:16px;padding:12px}
    .metric b{display:block;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-0.03em; text-align:center}
    .metric span{display:block;margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:750;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}

    .how{margin-top:16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);gap:10px}
    .step{border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-white) / 0.10);background:var(--glass-1);border-radius:16px;padding:12px}
    .step .n{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:10px;background: rgb(var(--c-blue) / 0.24);border:1px solid rgb(var(--c-blue) / 0.52);color: var(--svx-blueText);font-weight:1000}
    .step b{display:block;margin-top:10px;font-size:13px; text-align:center}
    .step p{margin:7px 0 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
